You will shape how software is purchased, governed, tracked, optimized, and reported across a large technology landscape. The role combines licensing expertise, compliance management, vendor relations, financial optimization, and strategic IT governance. The position offers significant influence over enterprise technology investments, risk management, and software lifecycle strategies.
